text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship is finally<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our strategy is to clinch the title of<n>Umamusume of
the Year by<n>overpowering the competition with<n>Taiki
Shuttle's sheer power and<n>speed. However...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I want a redo, a reprise, and a<n>rematch! I'm beating
Suzuka next<n>time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... That's the spirit, El Condor<n>Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, even should you best<n>Suzuka, I won't be
giving up the top<n>seat to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Remember, the peak of the Japan<n>Cup is none
other than the throne of<n>the Empress!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, it's the perch for the Phantom<n>Bird! I won't lose
to you—ever!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
This year's Twinkle Series is shaping<n>up to be very
exciting.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. This time around, we have<n>Grass Wonder,
El Condor Pasa, and<n>Taiki Shuttle—the current
sprinter<n>champion.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention Silence Suzuka, who's<n>really been
knocking it out of the park<n>recently.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Since returning from Hong Kong, her<n>winning streak
has shown no sign of<n>ending! Even with top
runners as her<n>opponents!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If she claims first place in the Japan<n>Cup, the title of
Umamusume of the<n>Year is practically hers for the
taking.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What if the winner turns out to be El<n>Condor Pasa
or Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well... I presume the title will go to<n>whoever wins,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle has won all her G1 races<n>so far. If she
places first in the Mile<n>Championship, she'll secure
a<n>fantastic record in the G1 sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, I doubt Silence Suzuka's<n>momentum will
let up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There must be something else Taiki<n>can do to attain
the honor of being<n>Umamusume of the Year...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Hey there! I just took alap 'round the track!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, Trainer. Why the long face?<n>Are ya feelin'
blue?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I choose to believe in Taiki Shuttle's<n>potential. I
won't doubt her ever<n>again.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm prepared to consider every option<n>for the
chance of grasping onto even<n>a single glimmer of
hope.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, if ya say you're all right, then<n>okay!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Sorry, Trainer, but can we finish<n>up here for
today?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeppers! Somebody wants to see me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And that somebody is Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzukaaa! Sorry I'm late!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hi, Taiki. It's okay. Thank you for<n>coming.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're more than welcome! ♪ Now<n>then...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What'd ya wanna talk about?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Do you remember last year's Mile<n>Championship?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We ran in it together! Boy,<n>that was one
exciting race!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. I can't seem to forget it either.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I ever will. It's burned<n>into my
memory.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Taiki... Your speed is still so vivid in<n>my mind.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't stop chasing the speed you<n>showed me
that day... and the<n>shadow you left behind.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I decided to stop holding back when I<n>run. I've
stayed at top speed since<n>then, race after race—so
that one day I<n>could catch up to your shadow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And yet, running at full speed hasn't<n>been enough.
Your shadow is still<n>there in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So... Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want to challenge you at the next<n>Mile
Championship.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship?! But aren't<n>ya supposed
to run in the Japan<n>Cup?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Not anymore. I can't keep chasing<n>after your
shadow!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I... want to go beyond it. I want to see<n>the scenery
that lies beyond your top<n>speed.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's all I wanted to say.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Let's meet again on the track, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle relays the conversation<n>back to me.
Finding out that Silence<n>Suzuka has declared war is
shocking,<n>to say the least...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Trainer, I've been chewin' it<n>over...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I reckon this is a huge chance for<n>me!
Whaddya think?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka is currently the<n>top-ranked
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Butting heads with her in a G1 race is<n>nothing short
of an enormous<n>challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, should Taiki Shuttle come<n>out of the battle
victorious...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This could be an opportunity to<n>overthrow Silence
Suzuka's hold on<n>everyone's hearts using Taiki's
power and speed!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen Suzuka burnin' so<n>brightly. She
was intense.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I could tell all that talk about catchin'<n>up and
overtaking me was coming<n>straight from the heart.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I don't plan on losin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There can only be one King of the<n>Mile! And only
one Umamusume of<n>the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna claim both titles with these<n>legs of mine!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle's chances of becoming<n>Umamusume
of the Year hinge on the<n>results of the Mile
Championship!
